newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas in deal to transfer units.
newsitem.headline: Paribas in deal to transfer units.

text.p: Groupe Paribas said on Thursday it and the Bank of Hawaii had adopted a memorandum of intention to transfer 85 percent of Banque Paribas Pacifique and 70 percent of Banque Paribas Polynesie to Bank of Hawaii International Inc or its units Banque de Tahiti and Banque de Nouvelle Caledonie.
Paribas said that if the sale went through, Bank of Hawaii would at the same time launch a tender offer to minority shareholders on the same terms as those offered to Paribas.
The deal was set to close before the end of the third quarter of 1997.
Paribas gave no financial details about the deal, but said it was in keeping with its strategy of focusing on its core business of international investment banking.
It said Bank of Hawaii is a unit of Pacific Century Financial Corp.
